body:
Founder reported: downloaded a new REDGARDEN client, stuck on queueing, nothing happening. Investigation found the real root cause: redgarden-auto-deploy.timer had been correctly detecting new green builds (from this session's own Michael/item commits, which changed the wire protocol -- added shield_hp to ArenaHeroSnapshot -- and ARENA_HERO_COUNT) and publishing fresh binaries to build/ every ~10 minutes since 03:57 UTC, but perpetually deferring the actual systemd restart with 'a match server is currently running' -- because the R&D bot-pool matchmaker (:7778, the client's own default port, confirmed via apps/arena_bot's ARENA_MATCHMAKER_PORT define and the CI-generated PLAY.bat) runs a permanently self-sustaining 20-bot farm that is by design ALWAYS mid-match, so the safety guard (added after two real incidents of restarts killing live founder matches, Apple #11297 and a follow-up) can structurally never find a genuinely idle window for this specific matchmaker. Live services were still running 5-day-old binaries with the OLD wire protocol while a downloaded client built from today's commits used the NEW one -- a real client/server protocol mismatch, exactly matching the reported symptom. Fixed by confirming no real player match was at risk (only the harmless bot-farm match was active, verified via process inspection before touching anything) and manually restarting redgarden-matchmaker-bots/players.service + redgarden-bot-pool.service, then updating the auto-deploy state file to mark the SHA as deployed. Live-verified: restarted binaries contain today's real content (strings check for 'michael'/'RECAST VICTORY'), the bot-pool matchmaker is forming real matches with live gameplay data flowing, the player-only pool is stable. Real, structural gap named, not fixed this pass (safety-sensitive script, didn't want to rush a change to logic that exists specifically because of two past live-match-killing incidents): match_server_running()'s pgrep-any-arena-server check can't distinguish a real player match from the always-on bot farm, so this exact stall will very likely recur on every future deploy while the persistent bot pool is active -- a real fix needs a reliable way to tell bot-only matches apart from real player ones before it's safe to narrow the guard.

⚓ ☃
title: Real incident: R&D matchmaker/bot-pool stuck on 5-day-old binaries, auto-deploy silently stalled for ~1hr -- manually restarted, live client protocol mismatch fixed
